messages:
Jin: heads up — I sketched a lightweight metric we could use to detect meaningful spot capacity degradation across mixed pools. want feedback before i add it to grafana.
Marta: send it over, curious how you plan to avoid noisy pages.
Jin: idea: combine provider capacity signal + internal eviction/schedule-fail counters into a single score: `spot_avail_score` = 0.7*provider_capacity_pct + 0.3*(1 - smoothed_eviction_rate). smoothing window = 5m exp decay. yields 0-100.
Liam: so provider_capacity_pct is from cloud API polling? which metric name are we using?
Jin: for aws: `aws_spot_capacity_pct{instance_type,zone,pool}` from our capacity exporter. for gcp: `gce_preemptible_capacity_pct`. eviction_rate = `evictions_total` delta / `task_attempts_total` over same window.
Sasha: i like the combined score. question: how do we handle small pools where a single eviction looks huge?
Jin: we cap sensitivity by using a minimum request volume threshold + Bayesian shrinkage: effective_evictions = evictions + alpha; choose alpha equivalent to 10 requests. reduces noise for tiny pools.
Marta: alerting thresholds? i want a safe, gradated policy so SREs only page when SLOs are at risk.
Jin: proposal:
```
- warning: spot_avail_score < 75 for any prod pool for 10m (notify #eng-infra)
- action page: spot_avail_score < 60 sustained 15m OR rate of change drop > 20 points in 5m (page @oncall)
- auto-fallback: if score < 50 for 20m, trigger autoswitch to reserved fallback for affected routes
```
Liam: rate-of-change page seems good to catch sudden evictions. For the autoswitch, do we have playbook to avoid thrashing?
Jin: yes — add cooldown per pool: once fallback triggered, lock for 30m and require manual review if repeated 3 times in 24h. we can also route only a fraction of traffic to fallback initially (10% -> 50%).
Sasha: can we emit a histogram of interruption intervals? helps distinguish single cloud-wide wave vs localized zone flakiness.
Jin: good call. plan: `spot_interruption_interval_seconds` histogram; bucket up to 3600s. add Grafana panel that overlays global control-plane events.
Marta: what about cost signals? ops will need quick view of cost delta when fallback happens.
Jin: include derived metric `fallback_cost_delta_usd` computed from instance-hour rates * time-in-fallback * instance_count. surface as annotation on the grafana timeline and in the pager alert body.
Liam: can we avoid false positives from scheduled maintenance windows?
Jin: we'll ingest provider maintenance calendar (api) and suppress alerts for impacted zones if maintenance is active (but still log an event). also add tag `expected_maintenance` to score so dashboard shows reason.
infra-bot: deploy job queued: update/grafana/panels/spot_avail_dashboard.json -> sha a1b2c3 by jin (staging). :robot_face:
Sasha: thanks — once staging panel is up, i'll run a 48h smoke with synthetic load across heterogeneous pools to verify thresholds.
Marta: put runbook steps in the alert description: how to check eviction traces, fallback status, and cost delta link. make sure SRE can triage without asking product.
Jin: will do. i'll open an RFC doc and a short PR for the dashboard and alert rules. planning to roll to prod after 48h smoke if stats look sane.
Liam: +1. can you tag me on the PR for the cooldown/circuit logic?
Jin: done. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/482 (staging changes).
Sasha: :eyes: i'll start the synthetic run this afternoon.
Marta: thanks team. if we get persistent failures, we'll escalate to cloud-partners for capacity remediation.
Jin: noted — i'll wire the partner ticket template into the alert runbook so it's quick to file.
Liam: one tiny nit — make sure panels show pool cardinality (num instances) so we don't chase noisy single-instance pools.
Jin: will add `pool_size` annotation. closing the loop: i'll push the staging dashboard now and ping here when green.
infra-bot: deploy succeeded: staging grafana panel updated (sha a1b2c3).
Jin: staging panel is live: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/spot/spot-availability — comments welcome.
Sasha: looks good, starting smoke now.
Marta: moving to monitoring board — i'll schedule a 1h post-smoke sync tomorrow.
Jin: thanks all.
